fix: Remove the JWT secret from source, rotate it, and load it from an environment variable or secret manager.
Use a parameterized query such as `WHERE title LIKE $1` with `['%' + q + '%']` instead of interpolating q.
Resolve the path, verify it stays inside REPORT_DIR (or use path.basename / an allowlist of names) before calling sendFile.
Hash passwords with a slow salted algorithm such as bcrypt, scrypt or argon2 instead of unsalted MD5.
Validate the URL against an allowlist of hosts/schemes and block private, loopback and link-local addresses before fetching.
Require requireAdmin or add an ownership check (e.g. AND owner_id = $2) so users can delete only their own tickets.
Use execFile with an argument array and validate req.body.format against an allowlist such as csv/json.
